svg.title: placement-prep — flagship full-stack + AI project
svg.desc: Campus placement platform: the placement cell posts drives, students see only the ones they qualify for, and AI helps them prepare. 315 tests passing, 35 REST endpoints, 4 roles. AI resume feedback grounded in the job description, a tool-calling assistant, semantic job-description search on pgvector, JWT with row-level ownership, CI on every push. Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot 4.1, Spring Security, Spring AI 2.0, PostgreSQL with pgvector, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind, Docker.
